title: Correct a multi-tenant RAG vector and semantic-cache design
intent: Checks the answer requires a search-capable tier, filters tenant/ACL inside the vector query, aligns dimension/metric, and scopes the semantic cache by identity and version.
prompt: Critique and replace this multi-tenant RAG vector design on Azure Managed Redis, giving the corrected schema, query, ingestion, and cache boundaries.

input_artifacts.name: rag-design.txt
input_artifacts.content: index: one global vector index for all tenants; embeddings: 1536-dim, metric assumed default; query: KNN across all chunks then filter tenant and ACL in app code after generation; ingestion: append chunks on every re-ingest; semantic cache: keyed by normalized question only; no check that the tier supports the search/vector module

embedded_defects.defect: No verification that the tier and cluster policy support the search/vector module.
Tenant/ACL filtered in app code after generation instead of inside the vector query.
Distance metric not aligned to the embedding model.
Semantic cache keyed only by question, ignoring tenant, model, prompt, and KB version.
